title: ARCANA: A Benchmark for Abstraction and Analogical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.29271v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Analogical reasoning is widely considered a fundamental component of human intelligence. Few benchmarks are designed to explicitly test far analogical reasoning - reasoning between domains that are superficially dissimilar yet share deep relational or structural similarities. In this work, we introduce an analogical reasoning benchmark called Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus of ANAlogy (ARCANA). The tasks of ARCANA require performing far analogical mappings from real-world objects or physical phenomena to abstract grid-based transformations, different from the well-known ARC-AGI benchmark which primarily emphasized innate human priors. We validate ARCANA through a human study, demonstrating that humans solve these tasks reliably. In contrast, evaluations across a range of large language models show a distinct performance gap compared to humans, revealing systematic failure modes that remain challenging for current models. translated_abstract: 类比推理被广泛认为是人类智能的基本组成部分。然而，很少有基准测试专门用于测试远类比推理——即在表面上不相似、但在深层次关系或结构上相似的领域之间进行的推理。在本工作中，我们引入了一个名为ARCANA（抽象与类比推理语料库，Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus of ANAlogy）的类比推理基准。ARCANA的任务需要执行从现实世界物体或物理现象到抽象网格变换的远类比映射，这与著名的ARC-AGI基准不同，后者主要侧重于人类先天先验知识。我们通过人类实验验证了ARCANA，证明人类能够可靠地解决这些任务。相比之下，对一系列大语言模型的评估显示，其表现与人类存在明显的性能差距，揭示了当前模型仍然难以克服的系统性失败模式。
tldr: 提出了ARCANA基准，通过要求从现实世界物体或物理现象到抽象网格变换的远类比映射来测试抽象与类比推理能力，人类可以可靠地解决这些任务，但大语言模型的表现与人类存在明显差距。
